name: Amino Acid Hydration and Diffusion Force Field Benchmark
description: Compares force field predictions of amino acid hydration and diffusion properties across different water models to experimental or high-level reference data.
evaluation_method: RMSE / MAE and percent error against experimental or high-level reference data
reputation: A niche, domain-specific benchmark used by computational chemistry and molecular simulation researchers for force-field validation; relevant to force-field developers and methodologists.
notes: Scientific benchmark with limited size and scope (focused on amino acids and water models); not applicable to LLMs; results depend on simulation protocol and water model choices.
